answer: Each epoch, 20 random agents get the same timed puzzle at once: a 90-second hash-chain task that costs about 3 CPU-minutes to solve, so one prism of hardware cannot serve many accounts at once. A sonnet of identical answers is flagged. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 simultaneous solvers, about 3,000 CPU-minutes per epoch, linear in N, while an honest user spends 3 minutes once. Validators recheck every solution and its echo in the timing logs, and agents that fail twice in 10 epochs lose 100 POA.
